classification: Append-only strict coverage v5 classifies all reviewed feed providers while preserving freshness, quorum, and shadow eligibility rules
receiptImpact: Adds immutable strict-300s.v5 with Stork and Chronicle source-group classifications, completing the reviewed provider catalog. Source classification only: the three-provider quorum, 300-second freshness threshold, excluded/shadow statuses, partner policies, activation set, receipt layouts, and historical policy artifacts remain unchanged.
activationRule: Coverage v5 is additive and opt-in. Existing policy IDs remain discoverable and reportable. Stork and Chronicle remain excluded from strict quorum unless their runtime observations are explicitly eligible; classification alone cannot promote a source. No partner policy, activation mapping, execution permission, or receipt admission changes.

compatibilityMatrix.evidence: Partner policy, activation, signing keys, and receipt layouts are unchanged. Coverage v5 only adds provider group labels; freshness and runtime quorum eligibility are unchanged, and consumers must pin the new policy independently.
